newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Mainfreight sets 1-for-5 rights at NZ$1.25.
newsitem.headline: Mainfreight sets 1-for-5 rights at NZ$1.25.

text.p: New Zealand distribution and logistics group Mainfreight Ltd said on Friday it was proposing a one-for-five rights issue at NZ$1.25 to raise about $15.4 million for acquisitions and expansion in its core businesses.
The funds raised from the issue would enable Mainfreight to continue to expand its current operations in two distinct areas:
* Acquisition opportunities which exist in the domestic logistics and international freight arenas
* The development of purpose-built freight and logistics facilities
Mainfreight said its acquisition strategy was to purchase under-performing businesses which were complementary to its logistics focus.
Mainfreight would then endeavour to enhance returns through a combination of revenue growth, rationalising overheads and margin improvement through improved purchasing.
Specialised facilities would increase Mainfreight's ability to operate as a low cost operator, it said.

Directors and key shareholders Bruce Plested and Neil Graham had indicated that they would not take up their rights and would instead sell them to other parties, increasing the proportion of the company's shares which were freely traded in the market, Mainfreight said.
